mutations.because: One byte off at the boundary — 0x1f, US, walks through. This is the mutation a range check invites and the one a spot-check of NUL and ESC would never find: the check would still fail on the byte that started all this, still pass the whole tree, still refuse CR, and quietly admit the top of the C0 block forever. The test does not spot-check. It walks every byte from 0x00 to 0x1f individually and asserts the verdict for each against the tab/newline rule, then pins 0x7f, and pins 0x20, 0x7e and 0x80 as text on the other side of both boundaries. So the mutated predicate goes red on exactly one byte, and says which.
